description: This file defines classes and constants related to accessibility collection enums and their usage, including MatchType, SortOrder, TreeTraversalType, and the Collection class with methods for matching and traversal.

classes.name: MatchType
classes.description: Enumeration class for match types with lookup values.

classes.name: SortOrder
classes.description: Enumeration class for sort order options with lookup values.

classes.name: TreeTraversalType
classes.description: Enumeration class for tree traversal types with lookup values.

classes.name: Collection
classes.description: Main class providing methods for collection matching, traversal, and rule creation.

methods.name: isAncestorOf
methods.description: Checks if the current collection is an ancestor of the given object.

methods.name: createMatchRule
methods.description: Creates a new match rule with specified parameters.

methods.name: freeMatchRule
methods.description: Placeholder method for freeing a match rule (no implementation).

methods.name: getMatches
methods.description: Retrieves matches based on a rule, sort order, count, and traversal.

methods.name: getMatchesTo
methods.description: Retrieves matches to a specific object with given parameters.

methods.name: getMatchesFrom
methods.description: Retrieves matches from a specific object with given parameters.

methods.name: getActiveDescendant
methods.description: Returns the active descendant of the collection.
